import json,os,re,sys from pathlib import Path from astrid.installer.core import Version,absolute,current,read_json,version_id def launch_admission(version: Version, data: Path) -> bool: """Validate the selected managed launch; return whether it is activating.
The pending journal selects a version, never a process or stop authority. This function is also embedded verbatim in the generated command prelude. """ if version.root.parent.name != "versions": return False # Source checkouts are outside the managed launch contract. root = absolute(version.root.parent.parent) path = absolute(root / "update-transaction.json") try: selected = current(root) if selected is None or selected.document() != version.document(): raise ValueError("The managed launch is not the selected version.") if not path.exists(): return False transaction = read_json(path) if (transaction.get("format") != "astrid-install-update/v1" or not isinstance(transaction.get("operation_id"), str) or re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{32}", transaction["operation_id"]) is None or transaction.get("transaction_kind") not in {None, "app", "migration"} or absolute(transaction["data_root"]) != absolute(data)): raise ValueError("Invalid update journal identity.")
realm = transaction.get("realm") if (not isinstance(realm, dict) or not isinstance(realm.get("realm_id"), str) or not realm["realm_id"] or absolute(realm["realm_root"]) != Path(realm["realm_root"])): raise ValueError("Invalid update workspace identity.") terminal = transaction.get("step") in {"complete", "rolled_back"}
def retained(value): candidate = Version.load(value) folder = absolute(root / "versions" / version_id(candidate.root.name)) if (candidate.root != folder or not candidate.python.is_absolute() or not candidate.python.is_relative_to(folder) or not candidate.profile.is_relative_to(folder) or ("identity" in value and value["identity"] != candidate.document()["identity"]) or any(not isinstance(k, str) or not isinstance(v, str) for k, v in value["env"].items()) or any(str(candidate.document()[key]) != value[key] for key in ("root", "python", "profile")) or ((not terminal or (folder / "version.json").exists()) and Version.load(read_json(absolute(folder / "version.json"))).document() != candidate.document())): raise ValueError("Invalid managed update version.") return candidate
old = retained(transaction["old"]) candidate = retained(transaction["candidate"]) if transaction.get("candidate") else None step = transaction.get("step") if step in {"complete", "rolled_back"}: return False allowed = candidate if step == "switched" else old if step == "rollback_selected" else None if allowed is None or allowed.document() != version.document(): raise ValueError("The pending update does not permit this launch.") return True except (OSError, ValueError, TypeError, KeyError, AttributeError) as exc: action = ("Choose Pinokio's Update button to finish it." if version.managed_by == "pinokio" else "Run the install line to finish it: curl -fsSL https://astrid.haus/install | sh" if os.name != "nt" else "Run the install line to finish it: irm https://astrid.haus/install.ps1 | iex") raise ValueError("An Astrid update was interrupted; " + action) from exc
launch_admission(Version(Path('/astrid/versions/v1'),Path('/astrid/versions/v1/py/bin/python'),Path('/astrid/versions/v1/profile.json'),{'ASTRID_INSTALL_MANAGED_BY': '', 'ASTRID_INSTALL_RELEASE': '0', 'PATH': '/astrid/tools:/usr/bin:/bin', 'PYTHONUTF8': '1'},0,None),Path('/astrid data')) os.environ.update({'ASTRID_INSTALL_MANAGED_BY': '', 'ASTRID_INSTALL_RELEASE': '0', 'PATH': '/astrid/tools:/usr/bin:/bin', 'PYTHONUTF8': '1'}) from astrid_runtime.cli import main sys.exit(main(['run', '--profile', 'astrid', '--data-root', '/astrid data', '--source-manifest', '/astrid/versions/v1/profile.json']))
